d:
In this video, The Lallantop covers the high-stakes INDIA Bloc protest at Delhi's historic Ramlila Maidan, bringing you insightful newsroom debrief. Watch as the team decodes the atmosphere at the venue, analyzes speeches from top opposition leaders, and breaks down the core political messaging, public sentiment, and ground realities behind the massive rally.
Production: Pragati Chaurasia
Video Editor: Ved Prakash
